data_family_rule: JPY legs MUST use the synchronized *_M5_fetched.csv family (R1.1 frozen). Never the mixed plain *_M5 files (phantom 200-350 bps triangular violations on 2022-12-20).

CAD_CHF_JPY.caveat: first M5 bar of the common M5-only intersection (CADCHF real M5 begins 2022-09-12; earlier CADCHF bars are daily) + 200-bar causal z warmup

USD_CHF_JPY.caveat: SHORTER_DEVELOPMENT_WINDOW - USDCHF real M5 begins 2023-07-02; ~1.5y evidence, not equivalent to CAD_CHF_JPY depth

m5_cadence_rule: common timestamps restricted to M5 cadence (300s deltas) only; daily-era bars (2015-2021 CADCHF) excluded from the basis/z series; z warmup = 200 completed M5 bars, current excluded, ddof=0.

data_truth_repair.finding: The fetched/PRO family contains a systematic daily 20:00:00 UTC stale-print artifact: 64% of trading days show an anomalous single-bar spike-and-revert in CHFJPY (median 1-bar move 1.41 bps vs 5.72 bps at 20:00 UTC; p90 13.85 bps). 20:00 UTC = 15:00 EST sits INSIDE the frozen NY_AFTERNOON session and would create phantom z6 stops on open trades.
data_truth_repair.canonical_precedent: The canonical engine never faced this: its EURUSD_M5.csv leg has NO weekend bars (implicitly weekday-only series) and its London session (03:00-12:00 EST = 08:00-17:00 UTC) closed before the 20:00 UTC spike.
data_truth_repair.treatment: weekday-only (Mon-Fri) series + drop the daily 20:00:00 UTC stale-print bar. Documented as data-truth repair, identical in spirit to R1's fetched-family correction. NOT a parameter rescue; the artifact is a proven stale print, not a market dislocation.

verify_note: Exact file hashes verified against AJCF_R11_DATA_FAMILY_FREEZE.json at run time; engine fails closed on mismatch.
